item_verdicts.call_sites: no production call site: the change is confined to tests/conftest.py (test fixtures and helpers) and the new test module, neither of which reckon runtime code imports.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit (0f0483569 helpers and test, 8bc0e2250 evidence); preserve_seat_records now writes a home field via _mirror_seat_record and watcher_record_pids reads it through _record_home with the record's own directory as fallback, and _set_aside_seat_record_mirror merges with copytree(dirs_exist_ok=True) instead of replacing the aside.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is a test that arms a stub producer whose RECKON_HOME lies in a tree pruned before session end and asserts the session-end path signals it; tests/test_the_session_reap_signals_a_pruned_producer.py:93 asserts reapable_watch_pids returns the pid and that signal_worker ends the stub by SIGTERM, the base arm reproduces assert [] == [pid] and the missing earlier-cycle record (2 failed EXIT=1), and the head arm is 2 passed EXIT=0, re-run independently at 8bc0e2250.
item_verdicts.goal: §18's goal is that a mirrored seat record can be signalled by the session-end reap; preserve_seat_records writes the home each record was written under into the copy and watcher_record_pids reads it through _record_home, so a record whose original tree the prune removed still resolves to the producer's own RECKON_HOME (tests/conftest.py:283-361).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states commits 8bc0e2250 (evidence) and 0f0483569 (helpers and test), baseline 70 passed + 1 skipped EXIT=0, after 72 passed + 1 skipped EXIT=0, new module head 2 passed EXIT=0, and negative control 2 failed EXIT=1; every log path it names exists and its header line names the revision quoted.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff 0f5941a18..8bc0e2250 touches exactly three files, each a declared write path: tests/conftest.py, tests/test_the_session_reap_signals_a_pruned_producer.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-obligations-hook-reads-a-snapshot/the-session-reap-can-signal-a-pruned-producer.html (the declared docs/figures directory was not used).

justifications.durability: reverting either half reddens the gate: the base arm's derived-home conftest fails test one on assert [] == [pid], and its aside-replacing conftest fails test two on the missing first-home record, so the guard fails closed if the home field or the merge is removed; the test reads the reap's own pid list rather than a value it supplied.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_the_session_reap_signals_a_pruned_producer.py:93 asserts the session-end pid list contains the stub and that signal_worker terminates it by SIGTERM; the base arm reproduces assert [] == [3077891] and the missing alpha-00.lock, 2 failed EXIT=1, against a head arm of 2 passed EXIT=0, and I re-ran the head module independently at 8bc0e2250 for 2 passed.
justifications.fit: the new names state their mechanism (_SEAT_RECORD_HOME_FIELD, _mirror_seat_record, _record_home) and carry no plan, phase or ticket label; the mirrored-record home field is documented where it is written and read, and the change reuses the existing watch_record_dirs/preserve_seat_records idiom rather than adding a parallel path.
justifications.goal_fidelity: preserve_seat_records writes the home the record was written under into each mirror and watcher_record_pids resolves a record's home from that field (falling back to directory.parent.parent for an original), so reapable_watch_pids binds the mirrored record to the live producer's RECKON_HOME and the session-end reap signals it; the second gap §18 names, the aside replacing itself, is closed by merging each cycle into the existing aside.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff 0f5941a18..8bc0e2250 changes three files, all declared write paths, 270 insertions and 16 deletions, and every change serves the §18 done-when: the home field, its reader, the aside merge, the two tests, and the evidence record.
